summary: Sound Point Meridian Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) disclosing management's unaudited estimate of the net asset value per share of common stock as of May 31, 2026, within a range of $10.57 to $10.67. This is a routine quarterly NAV update for a closed-end fund, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return. There are no deal terms, advisor appointments, or structural changes. The filing is purely informational and provides no trigger for activist or restructuring scenarios. No risk-arb angle exists.
